name: Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan

flag.description: A white field with the Shahada, the Islamic declaration of faith, written across the center in black Arabic script.
flag.symbolism: The Shahada declares that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the messenger of God; the white field is said to stand for the purity of the faith.

hook: The Islamic Emirate is nothing but black Arabic calligraphy on plain white; Saudi Arabia writes the same words in white on green above a sword.
trivia: The Taliban first flew a plain white flag after taking Kabul in 1996 and added the black Shahada in 1997.
Russia became the first country to formally recognize the Taliban government, in July 2025.
